params.label: OSC SHIFT
params.tip: Shifts both oscillators by whole octaves.

params.label: KEYBOARD SHIFT
params.tip: Shifts the keyboard by whole octaves.

params.label: Part Detune
params.tip: Detune between the lower and upper part.

params.label: Indv Trig Switch
params.tip: Individual trigger: a MIDI note triggers the envelopes while the sound is played from another source.

params.label: Morph Bend Assign
params.tip: Bend lever also controls the morphing destinations.

params.label: Ext Trig Switch
params.tip: External trigger: the envelopes are triggered by sound at the external input.

params.label: Gate pattern
params.tip: The 16 steps of the trance gate (set by clicking the grid).

params.label: WAVEFORM
params.tip: LFO 1 waveform: TRI, SAW, SQR or S/H (random steps). It modulates pitch, filter and amp by the depth knobs.

params.label: RATE
params.tip: LFO 1 speed.

params.label: FADE
params.tip: LFO 1 fade time: how long it takes to reach full depth after a key press.

params.label: TEMPO SYNC
params.tip: Lock LFO 1 speed to the host tempo.

params.label: RING
params.tip: Ring modulator: multiplies OSC 1 and OSC 2 for metallic, bell like sounds.

params.label: OSC BALANCE
params.tip: Mix between OSC 1 (left) and OSC 2 (right).

params.label: X-MOD DEPTH
params.tip: Cross modulation: OSC 2 modulates the pitch of OSC 1. Not with SUPER SAW or NOISE.

params.label: LFO1 DEPTH
params.tip: LFO 1 depth on the destination chosen below.

params.label: LFO 1 + ENV DEST
params.tip: Where LFO 1 and the pitch envelope act: both oscillators, OSC 2 only, or the cross modulation depth.

params.label: A
params.tip: Pitch envelope attack time.

params.label: D
params.tip: Pitch envelope decay time.

params.label: ENV DEPTH
params.tip: How far the pitch envelope bends the pitch. Negative values start high and fall.

params.label: WAVEFORM
params.tip: OSC 1 waveform. SUPER SAW is the 7 saw stack. FEEDBACK OSC is mono only: it forces Mono or Legato and cannot be used with Unison.

params.label: CTRL 1
params.tip: CONTROL 1 of OSC 1. For SUPER SAW it spreads the six outer saws away from the centre.

params.label: CTRL 2
params.tip: CONTROL 2 of OSC 1. For SUPER SAW it sets how loud the outer saws are against the centre saw.

params.label: SYNC
params.tip: Hard sync: OSC 2 restarts with OSC 1. Not available with NOISE on OSC 2.

params.label: EXT
params.tip: External input as the OSC 2 source (External Input synthesis).

params.label: WAVEFORM
params.tip: OSC 2 waveform. NOISE is new on the JP-8080.

params.label: RANGE
params.tip: OSC 2 pitch in semitones against OSC 1 (-24 to +24).

params.label: FINE / WIDE
params.tip: OSC 2 fine tune, about -50 to +50 cent. With WIDE on it moves in whole octaves.

params.label: WIDE
params.tip: Wide: range and fine move OSC 2 in whole octaves, from -4 to +4.

params.label: PULSE WIDTH
params.tip: CONTROL 1 of OSC 2. For SQR it is the pulse width.

params.label: PWM DEPTH
params.tip: CONTROL 2 of OSC 2. For SQR it is how far LFO 1 moves the pulse width.

params.label: TYPE
params.tip: Filter type: high pass, band pass or low pass.

params.label: 24 dB
params.tip: Filter slope: lit is 24 dB per octave, dark is 12 dB per octave.

params.label: CUTOFF FREQ
params.tip: Filter cutoff frequency.

params.label: RESONANCE
params.tip: Resonance. At the top the filter rings on its own and gives a sine tone.

params.label: KEY FOLLOW
params.tip: How much the cutoff follows the key. +32 keeps the brightness the same over the keyboard.

params.label: LFO1 DEPTH
params.tip: How much LFO 1 moves the cutoff.

params.label: ENV DEPTH
params.tip: How much the filter envelope moves the cutoff. Negative values invert it.

params.label: A
params.tip: Filter envelope attack time.

params.label: D
params.tip: Filter envelope decay time.

params.label: S
params.tip: Filter envelope sustain level.

params.label: R
params.tip: Filter envelope release time.

params.label: LFO1 DEPTH
params.tip: How much LFO 1 moves the volume (tremolo) or, in Manual pan, the stereo position.

params.label: PAN
params.tip: Pan: OFF is centre, AUTO sweeps with LFO 1, MANUAL uses the LFO 1 depth knob as position.

params.label: LEVEL
params.tip: Amp level of the patch.

params.label: A
params.tip: Amp envelope attack time.

params.label: D
params.tip: Amp envelope decay time.

params.label: S
params.tip: Amp envelope sustain level.

params.label: R
params.tip: Amp envelope release time.

params.label: RATE
params.tip: LFO 2 speed. LFO 2 is moved by the mod lever.

params.label: DEPTH
params.tip: Mod lever depth for the destination chosen below.

params.label: DEPTH SELECT
params.tip: Chooses where the DEPTH knob applies: pitch (vibrato), filter or amp.

params.label: PORTAMENTO
params.tip: Portamento: pitch glides from note to note.

params.label: TIME
params.tip: Glide time.

params.label: VELOCITY
params.tip: Velocity switch: how hard you play changes the morphing destinations.

params.label: -OCT
params.tip: Osc shift down one octave.

params.label: +OCT
params.tip: Osc shift up one octave.

params.label: -OCT
params.tip: Keyboard shift down one octave.

params.label: +OCT
params.tip: Keyboard shift up one octave.

params.label: RIBBON / CTRL ASSIGN
params.tip: Press, then move a knob or slider: the ribbon controller and the control lever will move that parameter.

params.label: VELOCITY ASSIGN
params.tip: Press, then move a knob or slider to set how velocity changes it (morphing).

params.label: BEND UP
params.tip: Pitch bend range up, in semitones (0 to +24).

params.label: BEND DOWN
params.tip: Pitch bend range down, in semitones (-24 to 0).

params.label: RELATIVE
params.tip: Relative: the ribbon changes the value around where it is now. Dark is absolute.

params.label: HOLD
params.tip: Hold: the ribbon value stays when you lift your finger.

params.label: BASS
params.tip: Tone control: low shelf. Right of centre adds low end, left cuts it.

params.label: TREBLE
params.tip: Tone control: high shelf. Right of centre adds highs, left cuts them.

params.label: MULTI-FX LEVEL
params.tip: Level of the chorus, flanger, phaser or distortion chosen below.

params.label: DELAY TIME
params.tip: Delay time. The range depends on the delay type.

params.label: FEEDBACK
params.tip: How much of the delay comes back into itself.

params.label: DELAY LEVEL
params.tip: Delay level. 0 is off.

params.label: VOICE MOD SEND
params.tip: Send the patch into the Voice Modulator.

params.label: MULTI-FX TYPE
params.tip: Multi effects type. Twelve chorus, flanger and phaser types plus DISTORTION (new on the JP-8080). Distortion takes the place of the chorus.

params.label: DELAY TYPE
params.tip: Delay type: panning left to right, right to left, short panning, mono short or mono long.

params.label: LEVEL
params.tip: Master volume of the plugin.

params.label: PREVIEW
params.tip: Preview: shows or hides the keyboard strip with the BEND and MOD wheels, to play sounds without a MIDI keyboard. On by default.

params.label: PLAYER
params.tip: Player: shows or hides the player bar above the keyboard. It loops a short piece through the current sound, so you can test the sound without playing. Off by default.

params.label: ON / OFF
params.tip: Arpeggiator or RPS on or off.

params.label: HOLD
params.tip: Hold: keep the arpeggio going after you let go.

params.label: REC
params.tip: Record an RPS pattern (comes with the plugin).

params.label: ROM PLAY
params.tip: Play a built in RPS pattern (comes with the plugin).

params.label: TEMPO
params.tip: Tempo in BPM. In the plugin it follows the host tempo.

params.label: MODE
params.tip: Arpeggio mode, or RPS (realtime phrase sequencer).

params.label: RANGE
params.tip: Range in octaves.
Motion control 1: play back recorded knob and slider movements.
Motion control 2: a second set of recorded movements.

params.label: KEY MODE
params.tip: Single, dual (two layered patches) or split keyboard.

params.label: PANEL SELECT
params.tip: Which part the panel edits in Dual or Split. BOTH edits the two parts together; VOICE MOD edits the Voice Modulator.

params.label: PFM COMMON
params.tip: Bank 1. With EDIT on it opens the PFM COMMON parameter page.

params.label: VOICE MOD
params.tip: Bank 2. With EDIT on it opens the VOICE MOD parameter page.

params.label: PART
params.tip: Bank 3. With EDIT on it opens the PART parameter page.

params.label: PATCH
params.tip: Bank 4. With EDIT on it opens the PATCH parameter page.

params.label: MIDI
params.tip: Bank 5. With EDIT on it opens the MIDI parameter page.

params.label: SETUP
params.tip: Bank 6. With EDIT on it opens the SETUP parameter page.

params.label: INIT / UTIL
params.tip: Bank 7. With EDIT on it opens the INIT / UTIL parameter page.

params.label: SCOPE
params.tip: Bank 8. With EDIT on it opens the SCOPE parameter page.
Patch number 1 in the current bank.
Patch number 2 in the current bank.
Patch number 3 in the current bank.
Patch number 4 in the current bank.
Patch number 5 in the current bank.
Patch number 6 in the current bank.
Patch number 7 in the current bank.
Patch number 8 in the current bank.

params.label: PERFORM / PATCH
params.tip: Switch between the performance display and the patch display.

params.label: SHIFT
params.tip: Hold with another button for the second function.

params.label: EXIT
params.tip: Close a page, leave EDIT, cancel.

params.label: WRITE
params.tip: Save the sound (opens Save).

params.label: EDIT
params.tip: Edit mode: the BANK buttons open the parameter pages.

params.label: DEC
params.tip: Previous patch, or value down.

params.label: INC
params.tip: Next patch, or value up.

params.label: GROUP DOWN
params.tip: Previous group of 64 patches.

params.label: GROUP UP
params.tip: Next group of 64 patches.

params.label: MONO
params.tip: Mono: one note at a time, every note attacks.

params.label: LEGATO
params.tip: Legato: one note at a time, notes played legato join smoothly.

params.label: UNISON
params.tip: Unison: all voices play the same note. Detune spreads them. Cannot be used with FEEDBACK OSC.

params.label: UNISON DETUNE
params.tip: Difference between the highest and lowest unison voice, 0 to 50 cent.

params.label: VOICES
params.tip: Maximum number of voices: 8 or 10 like the hardware, up to 128. More voices use more CPU.

params.label: ENV TYPE IN SOLO
params.tip: ANALOG lets a new note continue from where the old envelope was, like old analog synths.

params.label: PATCH GAIN
params.tip: Gain of the patch: 0, +6 or +12 dB.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Voice Modulator on or off. With it on the polyphony drops to 8 on the JP-8080.

params.label: CONTROL 1
params.tip: Voice Modulator control 1. What it does is chosen on the VOICE MOD page.

params.label: CONTROL 2
params.tip: Voice Modulator control 2. What it does is chosen on the VOICE MOD page.

params.label: INST / LOWER
params.tip: Level of the instrument or lower input.

params.label: VOCAL / UPPER
params.tip: Level of the vocal or upper input.

params.label: REAR / FRONT
params.tip: Vocal input: dark is the rear jack, lit is the front mic jack.

params.label: VOICE ASSIGN
params.tip: How the voices are shared between the two parts (Dual and Split).

params.label: OUTPUT ASSIGN
params.tip: Mix both parts, or lower left and upper right.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Trance gate on or off. It chops the sound into steps in time with the tempo.

params.label: CUT DEPTH
params.tip: How low the sound falls between the steps. 0 dB means no cut, then down to -60 dB; the top position is fully silent.

params.label: SMOOTH
params.tip: Edge softness of every step. Low is a hard chop, high is a soft pulse.

params.label: DECAY
params.tip: Curve of each open step. 0 keeps it flat. Higher values let the note fall away toward the cut level before the next step, like a pluck.

params.label: SWELL
params.tip: Lets the gap before an open step rise back up toward full level, a reverse swell into the next note. 0 is off.

params.label: RATE
params.tip: Step length: 1/16 is the classic trance gate. (3) means triplet.

params.label: PATTERN
params.tip: Pattern: pick a built in rhythm or draw your own (then it reads USER).

params.label: POSITION
params.tip: Before FX: the delay tails keep ringing between gate steps. After FX: the gate chops the effects too. The preview sound only does BEFORE FX.

params.label: MIX READY
params.tip: Master switch of the whole processing chain. On by default, so every sound comes out ready for a track. Switch it off to hear the raw synth.

params.label: SOUND TYPE
params.tip: What kind of sound this is. The chain settings start from this type. Factory sounds set it for you.

params.label: APPLY TYPE
params.tip: Reset every module to the settings made for the chosen sound type.

params.label: OUT TRIM
params.tip: Final level trim after the limiter, -12 to +12 dB.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Drive stack on or off. Three stages in a row: opamp drive, transistor, fuzz (from PurrOne).

params.label: DRIVE
params.tip: Stage 1, opamp drive: smooth tanh saturation.

params.label: TRANS.
params.tip: Stage 2, transistor: asymmetric, adds even harmonics for warmth and weight.

params.label: FUZZ
params.tip: Stage 3, fuzz: lopsided and gritty with a smooth octave up growl.

params.label: MIX
params.tip: Blend between the clean and the driven sound.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Low end tools on or off.

params.label: POCKET HPF
params.tip: High pass that clears the low mids so the kick and bass keep their pocket. Pads and leads about 250 to 300 Hz, bass off.

params.label: LOW MONO
params.tip: Everything below this frequency is made mono (about 120 Hz). Keeps the low end solid on any system. The preview does not do this, the plugin will.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Mid/side EQ on or off.

params.label: MID PRES.
params.tip: Boost or cut around 3 kHz in the centre so the lead cuts through.

params.label: SIDE HPF
params.tip: High pass on the sides only, so the width stays out of the low end.

params.label: AIR
params.tip: High shelf at 10 kHz for sparkle.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Transient shaper on or off.

params.label: ATTACK
params.tip: More or less punch at the start of each note.

params.label: SUSTAIN
params.tip: More or less of the body after the start.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Resonance tamer on or off.

params.label: FOCUS
params.tip: Which harsh zone is calmed down: 3 to 5 kHz, 7 to 9 kHz or both.

params.label: DEPTH
params.tip: How much of the harsh peaks is pulled down. It only acts when they stick out.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Glue compressor on or off.

params.label: RATIO
params.tip: Compression ratio. Low ratios glue gently.

params.label: THRESH
params.tip: Level where the compressor starts. Set for about 1.5 to 2 dB of gain reduction.

params.label: ATTACK
params.tip: Slow attack keeps the punch. About 30 ms.

params.label: PARALLEL
params.tip: Blend of a heavily squashed copy (parallel compression) for size and density.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Stereo widener on or off.

params.label: MODE
params.tip: MICRO PITCH shifts the sides by about 7 cent with 10 and 15 ms delays (wide and mono safe). HAAS uses a short delay.

params.label: AMOUNT
params.tip: How wide the sound gets.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Slow auto pan on or off.

params.label: RATE
params.tip: Speed of the slow pan.

params.label: DEPTH
params.tip: How far the sound moves left and right.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Opto leveller on or off. A slow, program dependent compressor in the style of the classic LA-2A (our own model).

params.label: MODE
params.tip: COMPRESS is gentle (about 3:1), LIMIT is firm (about 20:1).

params.label: PEAK RED.
params.tip: Peak reduction, 0 to 100 like the hardware scale. More means more levelling. 22 gives about 2 to 3 dB on big chords.

params.label: GAIN
params.tip: Make up gain after the leveller, 0 to 100 like the hardware scale. 50 adds no extra gain.

params.label: MIX
params.tip: Blend of the levelled and the dry sound.

params.label: OTT low squash
params.tip: Low band: how much the loud parts are pushed down.

params.label: OTT mid squash
params.tip: Mid band: how much the loud parts are pushed down.

params.label: OTT high squash
params.tip: High band: how much the loud parts are pushed down.

params.label: OTT low lift
params.tip: Low band: how much the quiet parts are lifted.

params.label: OTT mid lift
params.tip: Mid band: how much the quiet parts are lifted.

params.label: OTT high lift
params.tip: High band: how much the quiet parts are lifted.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Squeeze on or off. Three bands: the loud parts go down and the quiet parts come up, for the big dense trance and hard dance sound.

params.label: DEPTH
params.tip: Blend of the squeezed and the dry sound, like the depth of an OTT. 12 to 18 percent is plenty on a synth that is already bright.

params.label: TIME
params.tip: Speed of the squeeze, fast on the left, slow on the right.

params.label: LOW
params.tip: Level of the low band.

params.label: MID
params.tip: Level of the mid band.

params.label: HIGH
params.tip: Level of the high band.

params.label: CLIPPER
params.tip: Soft clipper before the limiter. Shaves the peaks so the limiter can stay clean.

params.label: LIMITER
params.tip: True peak limiter on or off.

params.label: CLIP
params.tip: How much the clipper rounds the peaks.

params.label: LOUDNESS
params.tip: Level pushed into the limiter, 0 to 12 dB.

params.label: CEILING
params.tip: True peak ceiling of the limiter, -3.0 to 0.0 dB. -1.0 is safe for any format.

params.label: RELEASE
params.tip: Limiter release time.

params.label: LOOK AHEAD
params.tip: Limiter lookahead in half milliseconds. More is cleaner but adds latency.

params.label: ON
params.tip: Multiband compressor and limiter on or off. Four bands, each with its own compressor and its own limiter at the end.

params.label: MIX
params.tip: Blend of the squeezed and the dry sound. Below 100 percent is parallel compression.

params.label: LOW X
params.tip: Crossover between band 1 and band 2, 40 to 400 Hz. You can also drag the line in the display.

params.label: MID X
params.tip: Crossover between band 2 and band 3, 300 Hz to 3 kHz.

params.label: HIGH X
params.tip: Crossover between band 3 and band 4, 4 to 16 kHz.

params.label: BAND
params.tip: LOW band on or off. Off bands pass the sound untouched.

params.label: MUTE
params.tip: Silence this band to hear what the others do. Not saved with the sound.

params.label: SOLO
params.tip: Hear only this band. Not saved with the sound.

params.label: THRESH
params.tip: LOW compressor threshold. The signal above it is turned down.

params.label: RATIO
params.tip: LOW compressor ratio, 1:1 to 1:20.

params.label: ATTACK
params.tip: LOW compressor attack, 0.1 to 100 ms.

params.label: RELEASE
params.tip: LOW compressor release, 1 ms to 1 s. Far left is AUTO.

params.label: BOOST
params.tip: LOW make up gain after the compressor.

params.label: ON
params.tip: LOW limiter on or off. Every band has its own limiter at the end, so a loud band cannot punch through the others.

params.label: RELEASE
params.tip: LOW limiter release, 5 to 500 ms. Far left is AUTO.

params.label: OUTPUT
params.tip: LOW limiter ceiling, the loudest this band can get.

params.label: BAND
params.tip: LOW MID band on or off. Off bands pass the sound untouched.

params.label: MUTE
params.tip: Silence this band to hear what the others do. Not saved with the sound.

params.label: SOLO
params.tip: Hear only this band. Not saved with the sound.

params.label: THRESH
params.tip: LOW MID compressor threshold. The signal above it is turned down.

params.label: RATIO
params.tip: LOW MID compressor ratio, 1:1 to 1:20.

params.label: ATTACK
params.tip: LOW MID compressor attack, 0.1 to 100 ms.

params.label: RELEASE
params.tip: LOW MID compressor release, 1 ms to 1 s. Far left is AUTO.

params.label: BOOST
params.tip: LOW MID make up gain after the compressor.

params.label: ON
params.tip: LOW MID limiter on or off. Every band has its own limiter at the end, so a loud band cannot punch through the others.

params.label: RELEASE
params.tip: LOW MID limiter release, 5 to 500 ms. Far left is AUTO.

params.label: OUTPUT
params.tip: LOW MID limiter ceiling, the loudest this band can get.

params.label: BAND
params.tip: HIGH MID band on or off. Off bands pass the sound untouched.

params.label: MUTE
params.tip: Silence this band to hear what the others do. Not saved with the sound.

params.label: SOLO
params.tip: Hear only this band. Not saved with the sound.

params.label: THRESH
params.tip: HIGH MID compressor threshold. The signal above it is turned down.

params.label: RATIO
params.tip: HIGH MID compressor ratio, 1:1 to 1:20.

params.label: ATTACK
params.tip: HIGH MID compressor attack, 0.1 to 100 ms.

params.label: RELEASE
params.tip: HIGH MID compressor release, 1 ms to 1 s. Far left is AUTO.

params.label: BOOST
params.tip: HIGH MID make up gain after the compressor.

params.label: ON
params.tip: HIGH MID limiter on or off. Every band has its own limiter at the end, so a loud band cannot punch through the others.

params.label: RELEASE
params.tip: HIGH MID limiter release, 5 to 500 ms. Far left is AUTO.

params.label: OUTPUT
params.tip: HIGH MID limiter ceiling, the loudest this band can get.

params.label: BAND
params.tip: HIGH band on or off. Off bands pass the sound untouched.

params.label: MUTE
params.tip: Silence this band to hear what the others do. Not saved with the sound.

params.label: SOLO
params.tip: Hear only this band. Not saved with the sound.

params.label: THRESH
params.tip: HIGH compressor threshold. The signal above it is turned down.

params.label: RATIO
params.tip: HIGH compressor ratio, 1:1 to 1:20.

params.label: ATTACK
params.tip: HIGH compressor attack, 0.1 to 100 ms.

params.label: RELEASE
params.tip: HIGH compressor release, 1 ms to 1 s. Far left is AUTO.

params.label: BOOST
params.tip: HIGH make up gain after the compressor.

params.label: ON
params.tip: HIGH limiter on or off. Every band has its own limiter at the end, so a loud band cannot punch through the others.

params.label: RELEASE
params.tip: HIGH limiter release, 5 to 500 ms. Far left is AUTO.

params.label: OUTPUT
params.tip: HIGH limiter ceiling, the loudest this band can get.
